# Warlock AI Mistral

> Package: `@warlock.js/ai-mistral`

> Mistral AI adapter for @warlock.js/ai (OpenAI-compatible)

## Skills

- [ai-mistral](@warlock.js/ai-mistral/skills/SKILL.md): Mistral adapter for Warlock AI: `MistralSDK`, `MISTRAL_MODELS`, `MISTRAL_DEFAULT_PRICING`, `inferVisionCapability` and `inferReasoningCapability`. Use for "connect Mistral", streaming, tools, vision, reasoning, capability inference or pricing overrides through `sdk.model()`. Not this package → @warlock.js/ai for agents and workflows; @warlock.js/ai-openai for generic OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
